title: Emptying ETH from `ZKPay.sol`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  An attacker can call `ZKPay::query()`, which is supposed to be used with ERC20 tokens, but pass `NATIVE_ADDRESS` and specify a large amount of ETH. Then, `handleQueryPayment` will assume that this amount came from `msg.value`, so it will think the sender actually sent that ETH to the contract. ```solidity     function query(address asset, uint248 amount, QueryLogic.QueryRequest calldata queryRequest)         external         returns (bytes32 queryHash)     {         return _query(asset, amount, queryRequest);     }      funct
